items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: so that was Ernie and Curtis and Ali and I. And we got a job, we left there and we got a job at the Slim Jenkins in Oakland.

ctx.x: Scatman Crothers. An excellent pianist. So I got him, and so that association lasted — let’s see we played, as I said Buddy was the first one to leave and then Jimmy Shorter, he went back to Washington, D.C., Buddy went back to Los Angeles, so that was Ernie and Curtis and Ali and I. And we got a job, we left there and we got a job at the Slim Jenkins in Oakland. He was quite the guy. The place was in West Oakland at that time. And it was a cabaret, I mean first class.
What would your songlist have consisted of them? Kinds of tunes?
